property_summary: For any deposit and re-entrant counter-deposit made during withdrawAll, the reference clears credit only after the external call, wiping the re-entrant deposit so a subsequent withdrawAll pays nothing more (c retains the counter-deposit's ether); the mutant zeroes credit first, so the re-entrant deposit survives and a second withdrawAll drains it, leaving c's balance changed.
change_summary: Move the `credit[msg.sender]=0;` statement before the external call, changing state updates relative to the call.
